# src/components/wizard

Compiled from `contracts/rules`. Change a rule there (`npm run learn -- ...`), never here.

- **invariant** `wizard/apply-create-sample-data-reset-new`: Apply on create with sample data reset, so a new project starts from ITS OWN field defaults rather than whatever the previous document held.
- **invariant** `wizard/ask-graphic-type-question-dropdown-carrying`: Ask the graphic-TYPE question with ONE dropdown carrying BOTH levels: the shelves as SELECTABLE heading rows over `browsableGroups`, their member categories NBSP-indented under them, each row with its live count. Use no `<optgroup>` and no "All <shelf>" row - the heading itself is the whole-shelf answer. Option values are `group:<id>` or `cat:<id>`, and a category answer ALWAYS sets its shelf too.
- **invariant** `wizard/ask-pro-tier-thing-which-graphic`: Ask the Pro tier ONE thing: which graphic types the design language is rendered as, every box ticked by default and the LAST tick not removable. The first member in package order is the PRIMARY - previewed, refined, and the one the single-graphic ending handles. Compose members the moment the result lands, each through the same gate the primary took, and DROP and NAME one the gate refuses rather than shipping it.
- **invariant** `wizard/embed-every-font-source-fontpicker-offers`: EMBED every font source the FontPicker offers, so playout never depends on the machine fonts and the emitted code never references Google. Local Font Access stays Chromium-only and permission-gated.
- **invariant** `wizard/hold-user-key-only-unsaved-password`: Hold a user AI key only in the unsaved password-field state and submit it to the credentials endpoint. Never pass a key through the settings object, browser storage, query parameters, telemetry, logs or rendered error detail. Model lists are provider-scoped suggestions, not an application-wide allowlist.
- **invariant** `wizard/keep-prepare-erase-offer-never-applied`: Keep Prepare erase an OFFER and never applied pixels. `proposeEraseRect` scans on arrival so the strongest path is not opt-in, re-run on the CLEANED artwork after every accepted erase, and under the confidence bar propose NOTHING while naming the rule that refused. Keep its overlay CSS capability-local in `import/prepProposal.css`, never in `src/styles/`.
- **invariant** `wizard/keep-thread-composer-single-transcript-talk`: Keep ONE thread and ONE composer: a single transcript of talk turns plus earlier generations kept whole, each restorable, with restoring archiving whatever it displaces. The one textarea generates, talks or refines, the primary button follows the state, and the refine placeholder is retained so the composer answers to the same locator either way.
- **invariant** `wizard/keep-three-header-doors-distinct-destinations`: Keep the three header doors distinct destinations: the brand lockup is an `<a href="/">` to the public front page, `wz-home` beside it goes Home, and `wz-new-graphic` after it is the shared NewGraphicButton in shell order. Mid-walk it is a guarded start-over that keeps the draft; on Entry it is a no-op. Home stays one press from every step, and the close control only rewinds to the front page.
- **invariant** `wizard/keep-whole-import-graphic-capability-inside`: Keep the whole Import-graphic capability inside `wizard/import/` - the five steps, `DesignPrepCanvas`, `fieldAutoMap`, its CSS and its draft slice - with `import/index.ts` as the ONLY door into it. `.dependency-cruiser.cjs` refuses a deep import from outside, `draft.ts` re-exports the slice through that index, and `scripts/e2e-affected.mjs` maps the folder to the import specs.
- **invariant** `wizard/let-field-file-never-drew-arrive`: Let a field the file never drew arrive as a marquee on the PREVIEW, its box coming back as FRACTIONS of the artwork rect. Ask `fit: shrink` on the spec because a wrapping line would dodge the too-long warning, treat the drawn box AS the em box, give a CLICK a field-shaped default, and track the draw mode for the WHOLE step.
- **invariant** `wizard/let-geometry-propose-followers-author-edit`: Let geometry propose followers and the author edit them: `proposeFollowers` measures the runtime guess on the step render, outermost-first, never a group AND its contents. An untouched proposal emits NOTHING because the runtime derives it, and the FIRST EDIT materializes the whole set into `svgStretch.followers`. Render the list only where there is something to decide, and let growth alone open nothing.
- **invariant** `wizard/make-create-merged-describe-import-step`: Make Create with AI the MERGED describe and import step: one drop zone accepting images AND an existing template. A dropped template parses deterministically into a card offering the byte-faithful "open as code" import, which renders OUTSIDE the sign-in gate and must stay there, or a guided Convert. Only the AI actions are an account feature.
- **invariant** `wizard/measure-ink-erase-removes-split-lines`: MEASURE the ink an erase removes, split into LINES, and seed every field at create from that line own bounds, cap height, top and the edge it was set from - never from the loose rectangle the user drew. FieldsStep and StyleStep carry NO imported-design branches, because design mode never reaches them.
- **invariant** `wizard/measure-mark-legibility-warning-own-offscreen`: Measure the mark-legibility warning on its OWN offscreen frame, because the preview iframe deliberately carries no same-origin access and its pixels cannot be read from the app at all. Debounce past the preview own settle, skip entirely unless the draft carries a logo, and REPORT without ever repairing.
- **invariant** `wizard/offer-control-can-change-graphic-front`: Offer a control when it can change the graphic in front of the user, and HIDE it, never grey it, when it cannot. Ask the BUILT artifact rather than the category: `cssPaintsWith` for a colour or typeface role, `presetMovesSomething` for a motion card, `STEP_CATEGORIES` for a step reveal, `BRAND_MODES` for a brand. A control whose promise degrades to a no-op for some class of input names that class at the offer site, in the same commit as the control.
- **invariant** `wizard/offer-three-entry-cards-template-create`: Offer three entry cards - template, Create with AI, Import graphic - in a two-column grid, with the video strip separate and blank behind Advanced mode. Create with AI is the ONE AI door: NoaCG Pro is an execution TIER inside it, never a second card, and there is no kit card.
- **invariant** `wizard/offer-three-execution-tiers-under-settings`: Offer three execution tiers under one settings panel every tier can reach, defaulting to the managed tier when the server offers it and otherwise to bring-your-own-key. The stored id `custom` never changes however the label reads. The managed tiers name NO mechanism and pick no model; bring-your-own-key is the deliberate advanced surface. A tier this build cannot run is ABSENT, never greyed.
- **invariant** `wizard/offer-too-long-control-ladder-owner`: Offer the too-long control as a LADDER in the owner order - wider, wider-then-wrap, wrap, smaller, with shrink LAST - emitting `xy` as two rows on one panel. Never size against the frame, and re-derive with the rows until a growth control is touched.
- **invariant** `wizard/offer-universal-motion-bank-every-category`: Offer the universal motion bank in EVERY category, asking the BUILT TEMPLATE whether it has a unit to move rather than what category it is. Where the design has choreographies of its own they lead in their own grid with the six universal families under a "Simple motion" disclosure; where the design own presets ARE the whole-unit kind, the bank leads and those cards stand down.
- **invariant** `wizard/send-all-three-finish-doors-through`: Send all three Finish doors through `applyDraftProject`, which is what keeps them byte-identical. The editor path formats through Prettier, so an export path that skipped it would ship different HTML for the same choices.
- **invariant** `wizard/take-every-downstream-number-mode-artwork`: Take every downstream number in `design` mode from the artwork INTRINSIC pixel size. Offer Create from the Design step on, so every later step is an optional stop. Field specs live in `draft.designFields` in DESIGN pixels and become real placed fields at build through `withDesignFieldSpecs`, so wizard placement, editor, preview and export agree by construction.
- **invariant** `wizard/treat-import-graphic-setup-flow-second`: Treat Import graphic as a SETUP flow, not a second editor. Its one drop zone takes three MODES and never a branch: `design` for any raster, `svg` for the mapping step alone, and `file` for a finished template. What each step DOES is owned by docs/IMPORT_MVP.md and docs/SVG_IMPORT_PLAN.md; only what the wizard itself owns belongs here.
- **invariant** `wizard/treat-shared-facet-never-reads-never`: Treat the shared `ProjectFormatPicker` as not a facet - `browseTemplates` never reads it - so never put it inside the filter drawer. On Browse it is three bare selects in one row with each label hidden through `.project-format-label` but kept in the DOM for a screen reader: hide the WORDING, never the control. Every other caller renders the picker unchanged, and draft selection survives route switches.
- **invariant** `wizard/walk-kit-through-same-six-steps`: Walk a kit through the SAME six steps a single graphic does, with `KitPlan` making each step one graphic OF A SET, plus KitTray, KitLookStep and KitFinishStep. The tray is the second axis of progress in the rail vocabulary and is not navigation; the look question is a bordered card and never a modal; both Finish doors SAVE FIRST with every write claimed.
- **trap** `root/pick-timeline-dock-surface-code-never`: Pick the timeline dock surface from the CODE, never from the category.
- **trap** `wizard/accumulate-erase-marks-each-run-against`: Accumulate erase marks into `draft.designErases`, each run against the artwork as it stands, and REPLAY the survivors from `draft.designOriginal` when one is removed. A fill cannot be undone in place.
- **trap** `wizard/archive-current-result-before-recording-new`: Archive the current result BEFORE recording the new request, and record the request even when the box was empty and the brief came from the talk.
- **trap** `wizard/cancel-pending-lifecycle-demo-timers-debounced`: Cancel pending lifecycle-demo timers when a debounced srcdoc commits, push field values from a latest-template ref, and gate the auto-entrance on the document fonts being ready, capped.
- **trap** `wizard/gate-every-kit-preview-intersection-give`: Gate every kit preview on intersection, and give `.wz-kit-thumb` `pointer-events: none` so clicking the picture of the graphic you want toggles it.
- **trap** `wizard/give-only-step-whose-left-pane`: Give `.wz-body-working` only to a step whose left pane is a CANVAS. It lifts the measure cap and clamps the preview, which a form-shaped left pane cannot afford.
- **trap** `wizard/keep-browse-filter-state-creationwizard-back`: Keep Browse filter state in CreationWizard as `browseFilters` so Back returns with filters intact, and pass the setter as a REACT DISPATCH so chip toggles compose as functional updates.
- **trap** `wizard/locate-wizard-feedback-button-because-shell`: Locate the wizard feedback button by `data-area`, because the shell behind the wizard mounts a second one. Its header push is a CHAIN of sibling selectors, since the step counter is absent on Entry and the button is absent offline, and whichever exists first takes the auto margin.
- **trap** `wizard/never-let-anything-wizard-renders-navigate`: Never let anything the wizard renders navigate a live frame. WizardPreview mounts a NEW iframe per document, keyed on its generation, because replacing an existing frame `srcdoc` is a subframe navigation that joins the session history.
- **trap** `wizard/run-layer-hit-test-app-side`: Run the layer hit-test APP-SIDE against the pushed rects, because the iframe has no allow-same-origin, and tie-break as the editor canvas does: innermost by depth, then smallest box. Hold both handlers in a REF, never in state.
- **trap** `wizard/spread-every-handler-patches-make-visible`: SPREAD `svgStretch` in every handler that patches it. Make `followArmed` a visible MODE rather than a modifier, so an armed pick toggles a FOLLOWER and a pick on text does nothing.
- **rule** `root/send-new-projects-through-creationwizard-where`: Send new projects through the CreationWizard, where `variant.create(options)` generates the complete commented template applied with sample data reset. Finish is the flow ONE branch: open it in the editor, or export it without the editor ever opening - export is not a reward for opening the editor.
- **rule** `wizard/branch-pro-ending-size-set-never`: Branch the Pro ending on the SIZE of the set, never the tier: a set of more than one finishes through the kit ending into a production, and each member is renamed for its type because that name is the export slug and the playout folder an operator reads.
- **rule** `wizard/caption-browse-card-name-alone-say`: Caption a Browse card with the NAME alone and say what the graphic IS on the line under it. The style family is a FILTER, not an identity: it rides the last line beside complexity as a dim `.wz-style-tag`, never opposite the name and never in a per-family colour. The style row wears a `.wz-filter-lead` caption naming the question it answers.
- **rule** `wizard/carry-line-read-back-what-will`: Carry a one-line read-back of what will actually run on the settings button, so the common case needs no click. The panel is NOT a popover: it opens ITSELF whenever nothing is configured, and a floating sheet would cover the controls it exists to make work.
- **rule** `wizard/decide-drag-before-binding-kinds-picture`: Decide a DRAG before the binding kinds on a picture-filled backplate holding both roles on one marker, so a click ticks the picture and the ladder turns growth off. The canvas answers WHICH layer and the step decides what a pick MEANS. Anything spreading the inventories dedupes by id.
- **rule** `wizard/feed-footer-brand-chooser-browse-context`: Feed the footer brand chooser into Browse as `brandFamily` CONTEXT, never a filter: the package siblings rank first, no chip appears, Clear-all leaves it alone, and a genuine programme match always outranks it. It re-ranks without resetting the page, because the reader asked for those extra results and a re-rank should not take them away.
- **rule** `wizard/give-section-line-info-button-rest`: Give a section ONE line and an info button for the rest: title, one muted line, and an info holding what it does AND why it exists. A new section starts with that head, not a paragraph under a heading.
- **rule** `wizard/handle-pro-finding-step-cannot-repair`: Handle a Pro finding the step cannot repair by clamping categories to the supported set, demoting spec-field findings to warnings against a fixed contract with no repair loop, and standing refine and fix down, because regenerating is the honest move.
- **rule** `wizard/have-behaviour-pickers-explain-themselves-matcher`: Have the behaviour pickers explain themselves from the MATCHER and never from copy: the name under an empty box, the unmatched-count notice and the fill offer all read `words.json` through `matchRole`, a picker label is the role own `label`, and every fill pick carries a reason and one Undo.
- **rule** `wizard/have-export-create-save-library-optional`: Have Export create, SAVE to the library - not optional - and open ExportWindow OVER the wizard through `keepGalleryOpen`, so closing it returns to the last creation step and the editor is never revealed. A FAILED save deliberately lands in the editor instead, where the topbar failed status is visible.
- **rule** `wizard/hold-browse-cards-strict-info-budget`: Hold Browse cards to a strict info budget - category and subtype, top families, field summary from semantics, at most three capability badges, complexity, style family - and put everything the budget excludes one info click away in the card detail panel. That button is a SIBLING of the card button, never nested, and one panel is open at a time.
- **rule** `wizard/hold-meant-there-baked-text-draft`: Hold "it is meant to be there / no baked text" as DRAFT state in `designKeepBakedText`, cleared by marking it and reset by a fresh drop. Have the Text step re-scan and SAY SO when detected text remains un-erased, offering a back-to-Prepare door beside the keep answer, and never block Next: the fact travels.
- **rule** `wizard/inject-harness-validator-every-provider-call`: Inject the harness validator into every provider call, stream the progress stages into the busy line, show the route badge on the result card, and pass a grounded result spec back on refine so spec-level refinement re-assembles deterministically.
- **rule** `wizard/keep-brand-mark-own-draft-field`: Keep the brand mark its own draft field, never one of `importedImages`, and let `draftToOptions` decide PER DESIGN whether it travels: never to a design with no logo slot, and never to a picture slot such as a presenter avatar or cover artwork. Create writes NO brand record - Home owns making one.
- **rule** `wizard/keep-legibility-settings-shared-control-viewing`: Keep the legibility settings ONE shared control - the viewing-target select and the two size-floor toggles are mirrors of one tri-state and interlock in the component. Render it on the AI step and the editor Style panel, NOT on the catalog walk. It is PROJECT METADATA riding `draft.legibility`, never the `:root` contract, and every AI generation resolves it into the request while the result card stamps what its request carried.
- **rule** `wizard/keep-smallest-managed-tier-smallest-result`: Keep the smallest managed tier smallest: one result, remaining allowance, at most two fields, no image or logo input and no style reference, with provider and model settings, brainstorm, raw mode, alternatives, conversion and code repair all hidden. An unsupported response shows the server explanation and one simplification, and acceptance is recorded by generation id, which is transient and never enters the template or the saved graphic.
- **rule** `wizard/lead-entry-hero-landing-page-headline`: Lead the entry hero with the landing page headline verbatim and a subtitle naming BOTH routes to air - the cloud control panel and every export target, never a sample of three. Carry no second brand mark and no export-target chip row: a new export target updates this copy.
- **rule** `wizard/list-saved-brands-name-footer-brand`: List SAVED brands by name in the footer brand chooser and show no control at all when there are none - never a disabled one. It starts at None even when one brand is the default, because matching is explicit; creating inside a PRODUCTION is the one exception, where a show that names a brand preselects it and one that only captured a look is offered that look under a synthetic entry.
- **rule** `wizard/make-add-production-primary-finish-door`: Make "Add to the production" the primary Finish door: it applies with `skipNavigation` and `keepGalleryOpen` exactly as Export does, so the editor never flashes on the way to the rundown, and a failed save leaves the wizard open on Finish to press again. It CONFIRMS first through `WizardConfirm`, and that dialog PRINTS the production by name.
- **rule** `wizard/make-blank-setup-step-never-immediate`: Make blank a setup step, never an immediate default-format create. The import-images continuation keeps the old ImportStep to TemplateStep flow and its indices, the catalog flow later steps sit one index earlier, and FINISH follows Animation in every mode.
- **rule** `wizard/make-kit-look-question-deterministic-transform`: Make the kit look question a deterministic transform over the `:root` contract and nothing else: `kitLookPatch` carries a motion preset only where the target design DECLARES it, and the chosen brand reaches every graphic of the set. The kit last rail entry is not a jump target, while re-finishing the tone-setter re-propagates.
- **rule** `wizard/measure-growth-default-where-artwork-unambiguous`: MEASURE the growth default with `proposeBannerGrowth` where the artwork is unambiguous: a banner rectangle whose STACKED bound lines are all start-anchored, with room before the margin, defaults to the whole grow ladder. A pair sharing one baseline argues neither way; no stacked line, a non-start anchor, a full-frame backplate or a quiz behaviour keep shrink and the step asks.
- **rule** `wizard/name-template-dishonestly-zero-results-offer`: Name no template dishonestly on zero results: offer to remove the most limiting filter - computed as the chip whose removal restores the most results - and hand off to Create with AI.
- **rule** `wizard/offer-fix-these-failing-non-managed`: Offer "fix these" on a failing non-managed result as a BUTTON and never an automatic loop, sending the exact validator findings back as the instruction at CODE level. Use the per-card verdict class, not the one that names the verdict on the current result. The smallest managed tier instead labels the same failure a platform defect and spends no repair call.
- **rule** `wizard/offer-only-palette-roles-design-actually`: Offer only the palette roles `cssPaintsWith` says the design paints with, and let the same question decide its TYPEFACE roles (`FONT_ROLES`), whose overrides are keyed by the BARE variable name like every other one on the step. The Style step carries two size knobs, graphic size and text size.
- **rule** `wizard/offer-panel-picker-only-shapes-bound`: Offer in the panel picker only shapes a bound line sits in, drawn OR placed - the pair `svgFitNodes` walks - because the runtime grants any other zero.
- **rule** `wizard/put-format-picker-search-above-kit`: Put the format picker and the SEARCH above the kit branch as one box - designs on one side, shows and the graphics a kit can hold on the other - with the facets standing down. Filtering hides rows and never unticks them, and the count stays the whole SELECTION.
- **rule** `wizard/read-project-format-back-foot-rail`: Read the project format back at the foot of the rail for the whole walk while the control that sets it stays in the step that owns it - Browse, AI or blank. One decision, one home. Below 768px the rail lies down as a scrolling chip strip and that read-back stands down.
- **rule** `wizard/report-pro-result-card-language-rationale`: Report on the Pro result card the language, its rationale, its palette and every divergence the platform recorded, keyed to the template by WeakMap so a restored past result shows its own. There is NO concept image: the graphic rendered above the card IS the answer.
- **rule** `wizard/resolve-deep-linked-through-hit-apply`: Resolve a deep-linked `#/new/<variantId>` through `pendingDesignId` and `variantById`, and on a hit apply the SAME patch a BrowseStep card click applies, jumping straight to Fields in template mode - never creating a project, because Finish stays the only door that does. An id that does not resolve falls through to the ordinary Entry-step open.
- **rule** `wizard/show-chip-whole-type-answer-naming`: Show ONE chip for the whole type answer, naming the narrowest level and clearing both levels. Carry no member-category chip row.
- **rule** `wizard/show-home-row-full-width-graphics`: Show the Home row full width, with the Graphics and Productions shortcuts as SIBLINGS of the body button, and only when there is saved work. Keep the video strip to ONE line with no label of its own, flush with the card grid.
- **rule** `wizard/snapshot-walk-each-three-appliers-finish`: Snapshot the walk as a `FinishedWalk` in each of the three appliers when a Finish door closes the wizard. Re-opening onto a `#/new/.../step/<name>` url offers it back behind a warning naming what re-entering resets, while a plain `#/new` means a fresh wizard and discards it. A second pass saves OVER the record that walk made, through `saveBuiltGraphic` and never `saveGraphicAs` directly.
- **rule** `wizard/stand-footer-quiet-create-project-shortcut`: Stand the footer quiet "Create project" shortcut down ON Finish, and offer it from every step before it.
- **rule** `wizard/take-finished-template-mode-through-two`: Take a finished template in `file` mode through a two-stop rail with the imported template as its own preview and the ordinary Finish doors, skipping Prepare, Text and Animation by having a MODE rather than a branch. Apply its code BYTE-FAITHFULLY, never through the formatter: the graphic NAME is the only edit.
- **rule** `wizard/take-only-assets-design-around-these`: Take only the as-is assets into the "design around these with a catalog template" escape, and continue into the images, category and template flow. Hand the as-is paths to the production validator so that screen rides the injected validator. A video composition passes no binding choice, since it reaches a picture through a declared image input.
- **rule** `wizard/take-video-mode-straight-instant-create`: Take video mode straight to an INSTANT create - prompt, generation-engine picker, duration, aspect, fps, transparency and asset upload - seeding the brief as the first chat turn and recording the engine on the project. Generation runs in the video shell chat, not the wizard. Creating or opening a video flips the document kind, and every catalog create path flips it back.
- **rule** `wizard/wear-beta-tag-inside-title-both`: Wear the Beta tag INSIDE the title of both AI doors, and say it in words on the AI card too: `ai-testing-note` LEADS the hint, inline, so the three-line reserve still holds. The fuller sentence is AiStep own info note - never a second notice pattern - and the door is never disabled.
- **rule** `wizard/write-speed-buttons-follow-template-own`: Write 0.6, 1 and 1.8 from the speed buttons, and follow the TEMPLATE own durations for the lifecycle demo stop and replay rather than a fixed pair. Have the easing dropdown react to the motion and show the plain names, dropping a choice to Auto when the picked motion cannot render the current curve.
